name: Breadcrumb
intro: Put Item parts inside List, with a Link for each destination. Mark the current item on Item.

parts.name: Root
parts.description: Set aria-label to name this navigation landmark.

props.name: wrap
props.description: Allows the trail to wrap instead of truncating earlier items.

parts.name: Item
parts.description: Groups a destination and its separator.

props.name: isCurrent
props.description: Marks this item as the current page.

parts.name: Link
parts.description: Renders a link, or current-page text when its Item is current.
